Topics · Hard times

What did a child ever do to deserve this?

No child bears another's load, the buried girl is asked why, a mother's heart kept. No full answer is known.

If you are in pain right now, you do not have to carry it alone. Please reach out to someone you trust, or to a local crisis line or emergency number. Find a helpline near you

Part 1 of 3

﴿قُلْ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ أَبْغِى رَبًّا وَهُوَ رَبُّ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ ۚ وَلَا تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ إِلَّا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "Is it other than Allāh I should desire as a lord while He is the Lord of all things? And every soul earns not [blame] except against itself, and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you concerning that over which you used to differ."

Quran · Al-An'am 6:164

Translation

The soul who sins, he shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be on him.

Original · Hebrew

הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַחֹטֵ֖את הִ֣יא תָמ֑וּת בֵּ֞ן לֹא־יִשָּׂ֣א ׀ בַּעֲוֺ֣ן הָאָ֗ב וְאָב֙ לֹ֤א יִשָּׂא֙ בַּעֲוֺ֣ן הַבֵּ֔ן צִדְקַ֤ת הַצַּדִּיק֙ עָלָ֣יו תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וְרִשְׁעַ֥ת הָרָשָׁ֖ע עָלָ֥יו תִּֽהְיֶֽה׃

Ezekiel · 18:20

World English Bible

If you are asking this about a particular child, you may want to stop here and only rest. For anyone who stays: the verse says no soul carries another's load. So a child's suffering is not a payment for a parent's failings, or a grandparent's, or a people's. Anyone who has told a family otherwise has said what the verse refuses. And what load could a small child have? Whatever else is unknown, this is one heavy thing you may put down.

A question for you

What weighs most in this question for you?

If you sayA child I know, or knew.
ThenThen you owe no one an argument today. Stay as long as you like, and leave when you like. There may be someone near you who can sit with you.
If you sayBlame, mine or someone else's.
ThenThat is the load this verse speaks of. It may take a long time to loosen.
If you sayThe injustice of it all.
ThenThen your protest stands, and what follows does not try to remove it.

Part 2 of 3

﴿وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ٨ بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍ قُتِلَتْ٩﴾

Translation of the meaning

And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked For what sin she was killed

Quran · At-Takwir 81:8-9

Look at how this question is put. A buried girl is asked, on the last day, for what offence she was killed. It is not asked to find something out. Its wording assumes the answer: there was none. She, the smallest person in the story, is the one addressed. In the Quran's picture of the end, the innocent child is no forgotten footnote. Her case is read out.

Part 3 of 3

﴿فَلَمَّا ذَهَبُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَأَجْمَعُوٓا۟ أَن يَجْعَلُوهُ فِى غَيَـٰبَتِ ٱلْجُبِّ ۚ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ لَتُنَبِّئَنَّهُم بِأَمْرِهِمْ هَـٰذَا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

So when they took him [out] and agreed to put him into the bottom of the well...[587] But We inspired to him, "You will surely inform them [someday] about this affair of theirs while they do not perceive [your identity]."

Translator's notes

[587] The conclusion of this sentence is estimated to be "...they tormented him."

Quran · Yusuf 12:15

﴿وَأَصْبَحَ فُؤَادُ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ فَـٰرِغًا ۖ إِن كَادَتْ لَتُبْدِى بِهِۦ لَوْلَآ أَن رَّبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قَلْبِهَا لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And the heart of Moses' mother became empty [of all else]. She was about to disclose [the matter concerning] him had We not bound fast her heart that she would be of the believers.

Quran · Al-Qasas 28:10

Translation

By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

Original · Ancient Greek

Πίστει Μωϋσῆς γεννηθεὶς ἐκρύβη τρίμηνον ὑπὸ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ, διότι εἶδον ἀστεῖον τὸ παιδίον καὶ οὐκ ἐφοβήθησαν τὸ διάταγμα τοῦ βασιλέως.

Hebrews · 11:23

World English Bible

Two more lines, and they are not explanations. A boy is dropped into the depths of a well by those who should have protected him, and the text says word reached him there: he was not alone. A mother lets her infant go, and her heart is left empty, and the text says so plainly. The book does not pretend that children are not hurt, or that parents do not break. It does not say why. No complete answer is known. It does say that dark place was not empty.

A question for you

What do you need from a page like this today?

If you sayNothing more. I will sit with it.
ThenThen sit. Nothing here will move.
If you sayTo be angry, and not be told to stop.
ThenYou may be. No line here asks you to stop.
If you sayTo know what I can do for children who are hurting.
ThenThat is the part of this question that is in human hands.

The same in the other books
